name: scene-saanj
title: Saanj
description: Dusk over flooded paddy: a sky mixed in OKLCH from apricot through rose to indigo, a line of ink palms, and a murmuration of six hundred rosy starlings flown by boids, which pours into the palms to roost and leaves at dawn. Quiet is one finished frame of the murmuration; warm an easier dusk with a smaller flock; playful makes the pointer, or the arrow keys, a hawk the flock parts around. The flock flies round slotted text.

budget.reason: The plate's own OKLCH colour, boids flock, paddy plots and palms, ported line for line.
